import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation details. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def prepare_event_details(headline: str, summary: str, scheduled_date: str, additional_info: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or name of the event. summary : str A comprehensive description of the event. May contain multiple paragraphs and formatting. scheduled_date : str The scheduled date of the event. additional_info : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string suitable for safe rendering in a browser. Notes ----- All user-provided content is escaped using `html.escape` to mitigate CWE-74 (Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component). This ensures that any HTML or script tags embedded in the input are treated as literal text rather than executable code. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to neutralize special characters safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_summary = html.escape(summary, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_additional_info = html.escape(additional_info, quote=True) # Populate the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_headline, event_description=safe_summary, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_additional_info ) return invitation_html.strip()
